### The Holy and the Lowly
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-holy-and-the-lowly-one-year-devotions-for-men-january-26.html
Passage: Luke 1:47-49
Points:
- Unlike modern culture's fascination with celebrity and self-promotion, Mary turned all focus away from herself toward God.
- Mary held no illusions of personal grandeur, marveling that the Holy One took notice of a lowly servant.
- She understood God's kindness to her in the larger context of His generational mercy to His people.
- God scatters the proud and self-sufficient, but exalts and satisfies those who come to Him in humility.

### A Christmas Carol for the Weak
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/a-christmas-carol-for-the-weak
Passage: Luke 1:46-55
Points:
- Mary’s song reveals that God is magnified in His people when our souls rejoice in Him.
- Christmas overturns worldly standards by showing that God displays His strength through rescuing the weak rather than recruiting the powerful.
- Steeped in Old Testament scripture, Mary recognizes God's enduring pattern of choosing what the world considers foolish and lowly.
- God's holiness means His ways run contrary to human pride, offering mercy to the humble while bringing down the self-exalted.
